recommended.title: The PlayerAdapter boundary becomes a module instead of a specification
recommended.acceptance: The ~260 lines of TypeScript in docs/DESKTOP_PLAYBACK.md section 3 exist as a module, and the four rules that make it a boundary are enforced mechanically rather than stated. REQUIRED: PlayerAdapterId, the closed PlayerRefusalCode union, canPlay returning a reason on BOTH branches, PlayerLoadRequest taking a PlaybackSession plus a candidateId and never a URL, getTracks, readAvSyncTelemetry, subscribe, and an idempotent dispose. REQUIRED: no shaka-player, mpv/libmpv, @tauri-apps/* or electron type is reachable from this module or anything it imports, enforced by an import-graph test on the model of the existing PROHIBITED_AV_INSTRUMENTATION scan and of build-target.test.ts -- and that test must be proven non-vacuous by planting an offender, the way build-target.test.ts already does. REQUIRED: no `any` anywhere in the module; no engine-handle passthrough of any name; no opaque config bag -- EngineConfig from engine.ts must not be promoted onto the boundary. THE EXISTING ShakaPlayerHandle IN engine.ts IS NOT THIS and is not replaced: it is the seam INSIDE the web implementation, one layer below, and section 3 says so explicitly.
recommended.notes: PROPOSED FOR gpt-architect RULING, round 80. Created unowned as part of the WINDOWS PRODUCT COMPLETION phase board so the proposal is machine-readable rather than prose, and NOT claimed before the verdict.
